record.oneLiner: SendGrid is an email delivery and marketing platform with a broad v3 REST API supporting API keys and basic auth.
record.verdictReason: SendGrid provides a comprehensive v3 REST API accessible via self-serve API keys or basic auth. A free account tier can be created immediately, and community MCP servers are actively maintained.

evidence.quote: To use an API key, pass an Authorization header with a value of Bearer , where you replace <Your-API-Key-Here> with the API Key that you created in the UI.
When using Basic Authentication, your username will always be apikey, and your password will be your API key.
When you sign up for a SendGrid account, you can start a 60-day free trial to explore the Email API and Marketing Campaigns features.
The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale and ensure your application can handle high volumes.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides comprehensive access to SendGrid's API v3 for email marketing, transactional email operations, dynamic template management, and detailed analytics.
